title: A Nica-amenable submonoid of a group which fails to embed in an amenable group
summary: We construct a weakly quasilattice-ordered submonoid of a group whose full semigroup $\mathrm{C}^*$-algebra is nuclear, while the monoid does not embed into any amenable group. Hence, Nica amenability, as well as the nuclearity of its semigroup C*-algebra, do not characterize embeddability into an amenable group for group-embeddable monoids.
